beats.say: Sad news: country legend John Anderson has died aged 71.
Rolling Stone reports that fellow artists have been paying tribute to the singer.
His musical journey started early, graduating in 1972 as Most Talented Senior Boy.
Over his legendary career, he scored more than 40 country singles.
Five of those beloved tracks went straight to number one.
His final studio album Years arrived on 10 April 2020.
Which John Anderson song will you play first?

facts: John David Anderson passed away on October 21 at the age of 71.
Rolling Stone reported that Zach Top and Red Clay Strays paid tribute to the late John Anderson.
He graduated from Apopka High School in 1972 and was nominated as Most Talented Senior Boy.
John Anderson charted more than 40 singles on the Billboard country music charts including five number ones.
His final album Years was released on April 10, 2020 on the Easy Eye Sound label.
